mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate of 0.3 percentage points or more over the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) of 2% or more signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 0.5% increase in FEDFUNDS and a 0.3pp rise in UNRATE over one month signals a tightening monetary policy coinciding with labor market softening, which increases discount rates and reduces earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both proxies move in the specified direction (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of 0.5% or more over two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) of 50,000 or more over the prior month signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) of 1.5% or more over the prior month signals strengthening aggregate demand, which raises earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in FEDFUNDS of 0.25% or more over the prior month signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where the trigger fires (t-test p > 0.05).
